verdict.rationale: The axis applies: Ollama is a local model server with a CLI. However, no evidence item documents a command to start or stop the server (such as a serve or stop subcommand). The pack shows other CLI commands (ollama run, pull, rm, launch) and a server at localhost:11434, but these are adjacent features, not server start/stop control.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start and stop the local model server from the command line
